product_name: SAMPLE Fig and Sea Salt Oat Bars
card_sentences: SAMPLE A Harlem baker and her brother make oat bars in a shared kitchen on 116th Street. They wanted a lunch-bag snack that keeps for two months without a fridge.
allergen_line_verbatim: SAMPLE Contains: wheat, oats processed with wheat, milk, eggs, soy, almonds, cashews and sesame. Made with butter from cows not treated with rBST.
may_contain_verbatim: SAMPLE May contain peanuts, other tree nuts and fish. Produced in a facility that also handles crustacean shellfish.
retailer_line: SAMPLE Union Market, 240 East Houston Street
